checklist.why: 3 bedroom(s) (county assessor). PHAs size vouchers at about 2 persons per bedroom; a bedroom must be a sleeping room with a window (HQS) and usually an openable egress window and a door. Extra bedrooms beyond the voucher size earn no extra subsidy.

Gross rent (rent + tenant-paid utilities) must be at or below the PHA payment standard, about $2,538-$3,102/month here for 3BR, and no higher than comparable unassisted rents. We do not estimate a rent for this house. Context only: at the low ceiling, 12 months of gross rent = 3.8% of the $804,300 estimated value (Boulder county assessor market value).

built 1956 (county assessor), before 1978: if a child under 6 will live there the PHA does a visual assessment of painted surfaces; deteriorated paint must be stabilised and pass clearance before move-in (24 CFR 35.1215). 0-bedroom and elderly-only units are exempt unless a child under 6 lives there.

NSPIRE: smoke alarm on every level, inside each bedroom and within 21 ft of each bedroom door; carbon-monoxide alarms where there are fuel-burning appliances or an attached garage. Not visible in any dataset.
a permanently installed, working heat source (no unvented space heaters) is required in HUD-designated climate zones; also hot and cold running water. Not visible in our data.
safe path from the unit door to the street; living room and each sleeping room need a window (HQS), and most PHAs want bedroom windows that open for escape.

no exterior or city-record warning signs (roof surface spread 6.7 cm); interior condition still needs the PHA inspection
